states.name: out_reg
states.meaning: 32-bit sticky capture register reflected by output out. Bit i is 0 after reset and becomes 1 after in[i] has a sampled 1-to-0 transition; once 1 it stays 1 until reset.

states.name: prev_in
states.meaning: 32-bit register holding the sampled in value from the immediately preceding posedge. It is used to detect per-bit 1-to-0 transitions and updates to current in on every posedge, including reset cycles.

rules.condition: At a sampled posedge, if reset == 1 then out is cleared to 0 for all bits; this overrides any capture or retained sticky bit.

At a sampled posedge with reset == 0, for each bit i: if out[i] was already 1, it remains 1; otherwise it becomes 1 exactly when prev_in[i] == 1 and in[i] == 0. If neither condition holds, bit i remains 0.
rules.spec_quote: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: The first sampled posedge after a reset==1 posedge for which reset==0; transition detection uses the in value sampled at the immediately preceding posedge, including a reset posedge.

mid: Optional mid-row changes, if present, occur after the sampled posedge and before the next posedge; they update the carried input values for the start of the next row but do not alter out until the next sampled posedge.
